scope: Fix both confirmed store search request-sharing and category-strip resume-position findings

changes: Share only identical in-flight summary reads across route-owned feed notifiers. Preserve independent parent/search filters, pagination, rows and generation guards.
Capture current user and SDK session identity before lookup. Drop sharing on account or session replacement, including a restored session with equal token contents.
Key queries by page, size, effective category, exact nonempty search string and nullable paid state. Normalize only already-equivalent All/empty values.
Remove tracked futures on success and failure, guard removal by future identity, cap tracked keys at 32 and keep no completed-response cache.

Drop pending lookup entries after a successful like mutation or album creation/count update so a subsequent refresh cannot join a pre-write snapshot. Failed likes do not discard an otherwise valid pending read.
Expose the shared response content as an unmodifiable list; parse the response only once.
resolved_findings.reproduced_before: Parent All/page-0 pending plus three opened/closed search scopes sent four identical concurrent HTTP requests.
resolved_findings.verified_after: The same scenario sends one HTTP request. Four repository callers finish; closed route scopes do not change the parent list.

changes: Separate pending selection/layout reveal from post-frame scheduling and route visibility.
Keep manual horizontal browsing on plain hide/resume. Schedule reveal only for initial layout, actual category/selection/viewport/typography/chip-geometry dependencies.
Keep real reveal work pending while hidden and resume once visible. Continue to use only the horizontal controller with finite bounded offsets.
Retain coalesced callbacks, bounded current-category keys and controller disposal; add no animation controller, timer or scroll listener.
resolved_findings.reproduced_before: Search return changed horizontal position from 930.5 to 0.0.
resolved_findings.verified_after: Search return preserves 930.5; parent vertical offset is unchanged. LTR/RTL, text scales 1.0/2.5, hidden selections and hidden layout changes also pass.

checked: Failure propagation and retry release use the same returned future; no discarded error-producing cleanup future is created.
A stale completion after session replacement or mutation invalidation cannot evict a newer request for the same query.
No notifier state or Ref is held by the request registry. Sharing does not couple parent/search generations or route ownership.
No new completed document/image cache, eager document generation, decode size, offscreen scroll extent or recurring work is introduced.
A plain TickerMode restoration does not mark reveal pending; actual hidden selection/geometry changes still resume and reveal the selected chip.
Old title/catalog identity fixes and StoreHub/StoreScreen/feed source files are byte-for-byte unchanged against the preceding review.

supabase_verification.test_query: Real SupabaseTemplateRepository/SupabaseClient requests intercepted using MockClient at fixture.invalid. Includes request separation, success/error cleanup, synthetic auth transitions, like writes and album/count writes; no live account or database was accessed.

limits: Tests verify controlled Flutter state/transport/cleanup behavior; actual device FPS and native process memory were not measured.
The sharing cap bounds registry retention, not the number of independently requested distinct queries. Existing HTTP work is not cancelled when a route closes or sharing is invalidated.
